g.text: Vigil icon directions — genuinely different systems
Different metaphors, different silhouettes, different construction · Audio/Listen is selected in every row
Dense medallions punched with simple symbols; tactile and immediately unlike the current outline set.
Replace generic UI metaphors with a doorway, hourglass, handbell, and writing quill.
Tiny points connected into meaning—quiet, nocturnal, and intentionally non-literal.
Treat navigation like a manuscript index: H, T, A, J as ornate typographic marks.
Broad, imperfect silhouettes inspired by devotional prints and old book ornaments.
An angular, segmented language—half reliquary geometry, half focused control system.
These are deliberately broad concept poles. Once one feels right, the chosen system can be normalized to a production-ready 24 px SVG set.
